description: This file declares the SessionServerManager class, which implements the ISessionServerManager interface for managing session server lifecycle, configuration, and state transitions within the Rialto media server component. It includes method declarations for initializing, starting, stopping, and configuring the session server, as well as handling ping requests and state changes.

classes.name: SessionServerManager
classes.description: Implements the ISessionServerManager interface to manage session server lifecycle, configuration, and state transitions within the Rialto media server.

methods.name: SessionServerManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SessionServerManager with references to required services and factory.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session server with command-line arguments.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the session server with socket name, state, resource capabilities, display name, and permissions.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the session server.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets various debug log levels for different components.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Handles a ping request with a given ID and acknowledgment sender.

methods.name: switchToActive
methods.description: Transitions the server to active state.

methods.name: switchToInactive
methods.description: Transitions the server to inactive state.

methods.name: switchToNotRunning
methods.description: Transitions the server to not running state.
